# logging

```go
import "github.com/acme/probe-cli/internal/adapter/outbound/logging"
```

Package logging adapts log/slog to the port.Logger outbound port.

The logger it wraps is the one built by internal/observability, so every record reaches both the console and the OTLP log pipeline, carrying the trace and span id of whatever is running.
